text:
sophia: New hire Hannah Park (remote, MA) starts Mon but ran into two onboarding blockers: 1) BG vendor needs a local police cert for a short-term UK conviction search (candidate lived in Toronto previously)  vendor estimates 5-7 days; 2) I-9 needs Section 2 verification  Hannah can't make it to Boston office until Wed. We need a plan so day 1 isn't blocked.

ben: Can we use a local authorized agent or vendor remote I-9? USCIS allows an authorized representative. Notary/vendor remote is usually faster. What's vendor timeline for the police cert step?

bg-agency: Vendor update: international name search flagged an address mismatch; they requested a Toronto police clearance or validated passport + local police stat. Estimated 5-7 business days for clearance if candidate submits police cert. Alternative: run identity-only checks (SSN trace + domestic checks) in 24-48 hrs but will mark international check pending.

oliver: For I-9, we can either (A) schedule an authorized agent near her, (B) use vendor remote verification (video + signed consent), or (C) send a Redwood rep (expensive). Which does she prefer?

karen (hiring manager): Hannah prefers (B) vendor remote verify if policy allows. She can do a 20-30 min video slot Tue morning. Also she can request Toronto police cert but it takes time. We need provisional access if BG unresolved.

it-bot: IT can provision an escorted-only laptop profile: expires in 7 days, no PROD access, VPN to onboarding apps only. Requires manager approval and signed candidate acknowledgement for supervised access.

sophia: Karen approved provisional access. Let's do remote vendor I-9 Tue 09:30 (candidate time) and issue escorted-only profile for Mon. If BG clears before day 3, elevate access.

notary-service: Vendor remote I-9 slot available Tue 09:30-10:00 EST. Cost $40; requires signed candidate consent link. They perform live video + show original ID. Provide timezone link and invite.

bg-agency: Candidate consent requested for international police check. Candidate can order police cert from Toronto online; estimated delivery 5 business days. We'll keep international record pending but can proceed with domestic checks.

karen: Okay sending Hannah the consent links now. Also confirm courier drop for welcome crate? She prefers same-day pickup at a nearby coworking space if possible.

courier-bot: We can do office hold at WeWork Boston Seaport (FlowSpace pickup) or ship to address. If holding at coworking, candidate must show ID and pickup code. Cost estimate $15 hold.

sophia: Let's hold at WeWork Seaport as pickup option X. Ship manifest will include benefits packet and paper W-4 in case she wants paper. Mark SIGNATURE_OPTIONAL.

it-bot: Created ticket INF-5109 for temporary profile "hannah-onboard". Will be toggled on Mon 07:30. Please confirm manager approval in this thread.

ben: Manager approval confirmed (ben). IT please send temporary credentials to candidate via secure DM only.

hiring note (sophia): Steps summary:
- Tue 09:30: remote vendor I-9 (consent sent)
- Mon morning: escorted-only profile active (expires in 7 days)
- Welcome crate held at WeWork Seaport pickup code 4521
- BG international police cert pending (candidate ordered) 
- If BG still pending after 7 days, escalate to security for extended provisional policy or reassign mentor for restricted access

notary-service: Consent received at 18:12. Slot confirmed Tue 09:30 EST. Candidate must present passport + SSN card/or passport + driver's license on camera.

bg-agency: Domestic checks cleared at 01:04 UTC. International police cert pending.

oliver: All right. I'll DM Hannah the pickup code and building directions + the IT temporary access instructions. If BG clears early, we'll upgrade her account and issue full badge.

sophia: Thanks team. Re-open thread if vendor changes ETA or if candidate can't make the remote I-9 slot. :white_check_mark:
